source.title: Iris 30" Ultralight Parachute - 2.6lb @ 15fps - Fruity Chutes Inc

proposals.identityRationale: Primary sources captured omit IFC-30-SL. The proposed 1.5 in dimension was extracted from the IFC-30-SUL (Iris Ultralight) product page. Catalog part ifc-030-sl specifies 1.9 in packed diameter, 3.2 in packed length, and 45 g mass. Mapping ifc-030-sl to IFC-30-SL is an unconfirmed hypothesis: the primary manufacturer construction tutorial page mentions Iris annular parachutes but does not establish SKU dimensions or weight. A third-party distributor lists 46 g, while the catalog lists 45 g; 45.4 g was an arithmetic conversion from 1.6 oz rather than an asserted primary source spec. Renaming or overwriting ifc-030-sl based on inference is prohibited.
proposals.conflicts: Conflation of Iris Ultralight (IFC-30-SUL) with catalog record ifc-030-sl. In addition, 1.5 in x 4.2 in dimensions assume deployment bag packing density (0.18 oz/cu in); traditional fold is ~0.13 oz/cu in.
proposals.dispositionEvidence: Proposal is placed on HOLD. SUL dimensions (1.5 in x 4.2 in) diverge from catalog record (1.9 in x 3.2 in), and a primary manufacturer source for IFC-30-SL is not captured. Overwriting or renaming ifc-030-sl from inference is prohibited.
proposals.rollbackRequirements: Retain existing catalog value 1.9 in. Prohibit overwrite.
